_note: General clinic questions, written for Dent Plus. Department-specific questions live on each treatment page (services.json).

items.q: Can I book for more than one family member?
items.a: Yes. Book each person separately, online or by phone. If you mention it at reception, the team will try to keep the appointments close together.

items.q: Which doctor should I book if I'm not sure?
items.a: Choose the department that fits best and pick the general option. The doctor will see you and, if another of our doctors is better placed, arrange that.

items.q: Do I need to bring anything?
items.a: Carry your current medicine strips or a written list, recent blood reports or X-rays, and your spectacles if you are coming for your eyes. For children, bring the vaccination card.
Pick a department or doctor, then a free time. We text a six-digit code to your mobile to confirm it is you, and the appointment is booked straight into the clinic's system.
Consultation fees are being confirmed by the clinic. Treatment costs depend on what the doctor finds and are explained before anything starts.
The clinic is on Ashok Nagar 3rd Lane off BSNL Office Road. Please call if you need help finding a place to stop.
Walk-ins are seen when there is space, but a booked time usually means a shorter wait.
